verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Vercel capability for private service-to-service networking that keeps internal traffic off the public internet. Deployment Protection (Vercel Authentication, passwords, trusted IPs), the WAF IP blocking and identity-provider access are adjacent access controls on public URLs, not private networking. The community remark that secure database connectivity requires contacting enterprise sales is not a documented capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity
